old_caption: The video showcases two rectangular metal sheets placed on a white cloth laid out on a wooden surface. The larger sheet on the right is significantly rusted, with patches of brown and orange rust covering its surface, while the smaller sheet on the left appears to be less affected, showing only minor signs of rust. Both sheets have some water droplets on their surfaces, suggesting they might have been recently exposed to moisture or cleaning. The background remains static throughout the video, focusing solely on the metal sheets and the cloth beneath them. There are no visible characters, animals, or additional objects moving in the scene. The lighting is consistent, indicating that the video was likely shot under natural light conditions. The camera remains stationary, providing a clear and steady view of the metal sheets and their condition.

caption: The video showcases a top-down view of two metal plates with rust-colored patterns resting on a white paper towel spread over a dark wooden surface. On the left lies a small rectangular plate whose upper band is smooth gray metal while its lower area shows a mottled rust-brown textured finish. To the right sits a larger square plate patterned with vertical wavy stripes alternating gray and rust across its top third, above a broad rust-brown field. A small cluster of clear water droplets beads on the upper-right stripe region of this plate. A rounded skin-colored object, likely a fingertip, is partially visible at the top center edge of the frame. Throughout the excerpt, every element—the plates, the droplet cluster, the rust patterns, the towel wrinkles, and the fingertip—holds an identical position from the first frame to the last. The clip captures a held, unchanging moment with no object motion or camera movement visible within its boundaries.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
